name: Ash-Blood Second Wind
description: Taste the old ash at the back of your throat and refuse to fall. Heals 1d10+1, once per fight.

name: Vow-Breaker's Strike
description: Put the whole weight of a broken oath behind one blow. A weapon attack that deals an extra 1d6 damage, once per fight.

name: Clause of Severance
description: Find the line in the contract where the debt ends, and cut there. A weapon attack that deals an extra 1d6 damage, twice per fight.

name: Grave-Salt Feint
description: A pinch of grave-salt flicked into the eyes, then the point of your blade. The foe makes a DC 12 Constitution save or takes 1d4 piercing damage and suffers Grave Chill. Once per fight.

name: Tallow-Spark
description: Pluck the note of a guttering candle and fling its flame at a foe. A spell attack dealing 1d10 fire damage. Costs nothing.

name: Chords of Unrest
description: Three discordant notes that strike like thrown iron and never miss, dealing 3d4+3 force damage.

name: Toll the Vesper
description: Ring the evening bell inside a foe's skull. They make a Wisdom save or take 2d8 radiant damage (half on a success).

name: Hollow Rasp
description: Breathe out the cold that lives where your heartbeat used to be. A spell attack dealing 1d8 cold damage. Costs nothing.

name: Borrowed Ember
description: Spend a little of the stolen warmth in your ribs as a burst of grave-light. The foe makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 radiant damage (half on a success).

name: Shroud of Ash
description: Pull the grey around you until the hurt forgets where you are. Heals 1d8+1, once per fight.

name: Ash Brand
description: Drag your blade through the ash of your old vow until it smoulders, then bring it down. A weapon attack that deals an extra 1d8 damage, once per fight. Learned at level 2.

name: Ledger Strike
description: Read the whole account of a foe in one glance and collect it all at once. A weapon attack that deals an extra 2d6 damage, once per fight. Learned at level 2.

name: Dirge of Tallow
description: Sing the long note that melts a candle down to its wick. The foe makes a Constitution save or takes 3d6 fire damage (half on a success). Learned at level 2.

name: Ember Vigil
description: Feed the cold ember in your ribs a little of your borrowed warmth and keep watch over your own heartbeat. Heals 1d6+2. Learned at level 2.
